description: This file contains the implementation of the RedisReminderTable class, which manages reminder entries in a Redis database for Orleans grains. It provides methods for initializing, reading, removing, and upserting reminder entries, utilizing Redis Sorted Sets and scripting for atomic operations. The class also handles serialization of reminder data to and from JSON, and manages Redis connections and key expirations.

classes.name: RedisReminderTable
classes.description: An internal class implementing IReminderTable for storing reminders in Redis with methods for CRUD operations, serialized with JSON, utilizing Redis Sorted Sets and Lua scripting for atomic updates.

methods.name: RedisReminderTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing RedisReminderTable with dependencies such as logger, cluster options, and redis options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets key expiration if configured.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a single reminder entry for a specific grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminder entries for a given grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specified range of indices.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder entry based on grain ID, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the entire Redis reminder table (for testing).

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry atomically using a Lua script.

methods.name: ConvertToEntry
methods.description: Deserializes a reminder entry from a JSON string stored in Redis.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Several overloads to generate Redis key ranges for filtering entries based on grain ID, reminder name, or eTag.

methods.name: ConvertFromEntry
methods.description: Serializes a ReminderEntry into a JSON string and generates a new eTag.

methods.name: LogDebugUpsertRow
methods.description: Logging method for debugging upsert operations.
